He later realized that the project should have hour long episodes. Korsh and his agent took the script to several production companies and wanted to give the script to [Universal Media Studios](/wiki/Universal_Media_Studios "Universal Media Studios"). *Girls* explores several topics across its six seasons. Dunham explains *Girls* never started with an "overt, political, or even [exact] artistic mission statement."[[14]](#cite_note-CL-14) While the primary themes in the television show explore interpersonal relationships—particularly female friendship and romantic affairs—New York City culture, coming-of-age struggle, career, mental health, artistic boundaries and self-reflection, Dunham states the show was never "stuck in any specific formula."[[14]](#cite_note-CL-14) She also noted "the series reflects a part of the population that hasn’t previously been seen on either film or television and fills the gap between the characters on *[Sex and the City](/wiki/Sex_and_the_City "Sex and the City")* and the [CW](/wiki/The_CW "The CW")’s *[Gossip Girl](/wiki/Gossip_Girl "Gossip Girl")*."[[15]](#cite_note-15) The series ultimately explores how significantly flawed, unlikable, morally ambiguous characters in their twenties navigate the challenges of adulthood and learn to embrace their imperfections.[[16]](#cite_note-16)[[17]](#cite_note-17)[[18]](#cite_note-18)

Further information: [NCAA basketball tournament selection process](/wiki/NCAA_basketball_tournament_selection_process "NCAA basketball tournament selection process")

The Selection Committee, which includes conference commissioners and university [athletic directors](/wiki/Athletic_director "Athletic director") appointed by the NCAA, determines the bracket during the week before the tournament. Since the results of several conference tournaments occurring during the same week can significantly impact the bracket, the Committee often makes several brackets for different results.

To make the bracket, the Committee ranks the whole field from 1 to 68; these are referred to as the *true seed*. The committee then divides the teams amongst the four regions, giving each a seed between No. 1 and No. 16. The same four seeds in all the regions are referred to as the *seed line* (i.e. the No. 6 seed line). Eight teams are doubled up and compete in the [First Four](/wiki/First_Four "First Four"). Two of the paired teams compete for No. 16 seeds, and the other two paired teams are the last at-large teams awarded bids to the tournament and compete for a seed line in the No. 10 to No. 14 range, which varies year to year based on the true seeds of the teams overall.[[13]](#cite_note-NCAABracketPrinciples-15)

The top four overall seeds are placed as No. 1 seeds in each region. The regions are paired so that if all the No. 1 seeds reached the Final Four true seed No. 1 would play No. 4 and No. 2 would play No. 3. The No. 2 teams are preferably placed so that the No. 5 true seed will not be paired with the No. 1 true seed. The committee ensures competitive balance among the top four seeds in each region by adding the true seed values up and comparing the values among the regions. If there is significant deviation, some teams will be moved among the regions to balance the true seed distribution.[[13]](#cite_note-NCAABracketPrinciples-15)

Aegean cat

Main article: [Aegean cat](/wiki/Aegean_cat "Aegean cat")

The Aegean is a cat of [Greek](/wiki/Greece "Greece") origin that has been developed since the 1990s by the Feline Federation of Greece, using cats from the [Cyclades](/wiki/Cyclades "Cyclades"). The name comes from the fact that the cats were originally found around the [Aegean Sea](/wiki/Aegean_Sea "Aegean Sea").[[2]](#cite_note-cats101-aegean-2) They are considered a national treasure of Greece.[[2]](#cite_note-cats101-aegean-2) Aegean cats are a [landrace](/wiki/Landrace "Landrace"), and are one of the oldest distinct populations of the domestic cat.[[2]](#cite_note-cats101-aegean-2) They have an affinity for fishing and water, and are numerous in Greek fishing ports.[[2]](#cite_note-cats101-aegean-2) It is a medium-sized, muscular cat[[2]](#cite_note-cats101-aegean-2) with a lighter European or Continental type body, medium-sized round paws, and green almond-shaped eyes.[[2]](#cite_note-cats101-aegean-2) The coat is always two or three colors, one of which is always white.[[2]](#cite_note-cats101-aegean-2) The breed is mostly free from common feline diseases.[[2]](#cite_note-cats101-aegean-2)
